title: Format Pack
description: The starting structure for a kind of video: sections of beats, each a share of the runtime with a purpose and an intensity. Written as TOML (see docs/format-packs.md); this schema describes the same data. A pack is data, never code.

id.description: A short unique name. A pack of yours with the same id replaces the shipped one.

typical_minutes.description: How long this kind of video usually is.

look_preset.description: The name of a look preset that suits it (for example Cinema Look). Empty for none.

targets.description: Named numbers the editing coach will use later (words per minute, shot length, and so on).

from.description: Where it starts, as a percentage of the runtime. Must be where the beat before it ended (within half a percent); the first beat starts at 0.

to.description: Where it ends. The last beat ends at 100.

intensity_end.description: For a beat that ramps: its intensity at the end, or across its copies.

sound.description: A note for the sound plan.

name.description: The name of each copy; {n} becomes its number.

repeat.description: The beat comes in several copies that share its time equally.
